title: Preferential Certificate of Origin
description: A certificate of origin issued under a free trade agreement, as a customs broker or trade-finance bank reads it: who exported what to whom, under which agreement, and who certified it.

certificate_number.description: The certificate number printed in the top-right box, exactly as printed.

form_title.description: The form's title naming the free trade agreement, e.g. 'Form for China-Costa Rica Free Trade Agreement'.

issued_in.description: The country the certificate was issued in, as printed after 'Issued in'.

name.description: Exporter's company name, first line of box 1.

address.description: Exporter's address as printed, joined into one line.

on_behalf_of.description: A company the exporter acts for, if box 1 names one after 'O/B' or 'on behalf of'; null otherwise.

address.description: Producer's address as printed, joined into one line.

name.description: Importer's name as printed, including any DBA.

address.description: Importer's address as printed, joined into one line.

transport.description: Box 4: means of transport and route.

departure_date.description: Departure date exactly as printed (do not reformat).

vessel.description: Vessel, flight, train or vehicle number as printed.

route.description: Any free-text route line in box 4, e.g. 'FROM X TO Y BY SEA'.

remarks.description: Box 5 remarks as printed; null if the box is empty or only asterisks.

items.description: Boxes 6-11: one entry per numbered goods line.

marks_and_numbers.description: Box 7 shipping marks for this item, as printed.

description.description: Box 8 description of goods for this item.

hs_code.description: Box 9 HS code exactly as printed, including any dot.

origin_criterion.description: Box 10 origin criterion code, without quotation marks, e.g. WO.

quantity.description: Box 11 gross weight or other quantity, exactly as printed with its unit.

total_packages_statement.description: The 'SAY ... ONLY' line stating the total number and kind of packages, as printed.

date.description: Invoice date exactly as printed (do not reformat).

incoterm_and_currency.description: The trade term and currency prefix printed before the value, e.g. 'FOB:USD'.

producing_country.description: Country the goods are declared to be produced in.

importing_country.description: Importing country named in the declaration.

place_and_date.description: Place and date line of the declaration, exactly as printed.

company_stamp_present.description: True if the exporter's company stamp/chop appears in box 13.

signed.description: True if box 13 carries a handwritten signature.

certification.description: Box 14: certification by the authorized body.

place_and_date.description: Place and date of certification, exactly as printed.

authority_stamp_present.description: True if the certifying authority's official stamp appears in box 14.

signed.description: True if box 14 carries a handwritten signature.

telephone.description: Certifying body's telephone number as printed.

fax.description: Certifying body's fax number as printed.

address.description: Certifying body's address as printed, joined into one line.

barcode_number.description: The digits printed under the barcode at the foot of the certificate.

form_serial.description: The preprinted form serial at the bottom-left (e.g. beginning 'AQSIQ').
